findings.title: index.md links to headings that do not exist anywhere in the docs source
locations: docs/src/index.md:24,30,33,36,38,66,67,87 — `@ref instruments`, `@ref check-docs`, `@ref check-consistency`, `@ref bug-hunt`, `@ref audit-changes`, `@ref rules`, `@ref RULE.DOC.ARGCOV`, `@ref "GBGCodingTools — architecture"`
findings.description: index.md's `@ref "The doctor's checks"` (used twice) does not resolve to any heading in the docs tree: `find docs -type f` returns exactly the 12 files that exist (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md plus this lane's 11 files), none titled 'The doctor's checks', and no guide/doctor.md file exists at all — though src/CLI/Init.jl:141 shows one is meant to (docs/src/guide/doctor.md is named in the tool's own surfaces.generated.globs). The same class of dead ref hits every other quoted-heading/id @ref in index.md pointing outside this lane's 11 files: instruments, check-docs, check-consistency, bug-hunt, audit-changes, rules, RULE.DOC.ARGCOV, and "GBGCodingTools — architecture" — none of these ids/headings are defined anywhere in the shipped docs/src tree (only ledger, rounds, config, install, verbs — the 5 @ids actually declared in guide/*.md — resolve). RULE.DOC.NO_DEAD_REFS bars exactly this, and an unresolved Documenter @ref fails the build (RULE.DOC.BUILD_VERIFY), contradicting the release checklist's `julia --project=docs docs/make.jl` exiting 0.
findings.resolution_hint: Either write the missing pages/anchors (instruments.md, rules.md, docs/src/architecture.md, docs/src/guide/doctor.md with a heading Documenter can resolve as "The doctor's checks") before wiring these links, or drop the forward @refs from index.md until those pages exist so the site it currently describes actually builds.

findings.title: "47 read-only checks" is stale — the doctor registers 49
locations: docs/src/index.md:49 — "47 read-only checks that a package is wired correctly"
src/CLI/Doctor.jl — 49 check!("…", …) registrations (lines 98–674), 6 of them in const DEEP (line 46)
findings.description: grep -c '^check!("' src/CLI/Doctor.jl counts 49 registered checks, not 47: 43 run by default and 6 more (LOAD.ENVS, BUILD.DOCS, SELF.DOCS, TEST.PKG, WITNESSES.ESCALATED, WITNESSES.BLOCKED) only under --deep. Neither the full count (49) nor the non-deep subset (43) matches the stated "47", so the figure is stale against the current check registry — a RULE.DOC.CURRENT violation, which requires every summary to match the code's present state.
findings.resolution_hint: Re-measure and update to the current count (49 total / 43 without --deep), phrased to match whichever set `gbg doctor` runs by default.
